primary_definition: R_m=arithmetic mean over nine year/horizon cells of raw-price MSE_m / same-record RW MSE
neural_ensemble_definition: Equal-weight point mean; concatenate LN components with each seed sigma expanded over its own components, or concatenate discrete atoms, then divide weights by three and score once
CRPS_implementation: Continuous: exact lognormal-mixture expectation formula checked against numerical CDF integration. Discrete: finite-CDF integration checked against quadratic distances.

bootstrap.method: Year-stratified paired noncircular moving-block percentile bootstrap; all horizons/platforms at one issue_date share multiplicity.
bootstrap.primary_statistic: R_FDMC / R_fixed_comparator; R_m = mean over nine cells of MSE_m_cell / MSE_RW_cell, recomputed within each bootstrap draw.
bootstrap.secondary_statistic: mean over nine cells of MSE_FDMC_cell / MSE_fixed_comparator_cell; descriptive, not the gate statistic.
limitations: Seeds are averaged before resampling and never count as independent market observations.
Comparator identities are fixed at their original-sample identities, including the selected best matched comparator.
No model-selection adjustment, simultaneous-coverage guarantee, or bootstrap model refitting is claimed.
Platforms receive their original within-cell record weights; the bootstrap does not impose equal platform weighting.
Block length and stratification are fixed protocol choices; there is no score-driven block-length search.

stability.criterion: At least 6/9 cells strictly beat RW and every year R <= 1.10

uncertainty.criterion: Paired percentile 95% upper bound of R_FDMC/R_fixed_best < 1
